title: UI风格#11 - Sakura Ethereal (樱之空)
description: 创建第11种UI风格：樱之空风格 - 日式和风、粉嫩配色、柔美线条。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planK.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Ethereal style When color palette Then features soft pinks, whites, gold accents on pale cream
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #FFB7C5 sakura pink, #FFF5F5 cream white, #D4AF37 gold, #F5F5DC beige palette

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Ethereal style When typography Then uses elegant fonts: Noto Serif JP, Cormorant, or Zen Antique
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Noto Serif JP (headers), Playfair Display fallback

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Ethereal style When layout Then asymmetric balance, generous margins, flowing scroll motifs
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: asymmetric zen layout, generous whitespace, flowing composition

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Ethereal style When UI elements Then soft shadows, rounded corners, gold foil accents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: soft shadows, 20-24px rounded corners, gold foil accents

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Ethereal UI When functional Then includes zen chat, kanji accents, petal animations
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: zen chat, harmonizer agents, falling sakura petal animation (15+ petals)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Ethereal UI When copy Then uses poetic Japanese-inspired: 'Harmony', 'Tranquil', 'Whisper', 'Petals'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'HARMONY. TRANQUIL. BLOOM.', buttons WHISPER/OFFER/BLOOM, status 'Breathing...'
